proven.finding: Physical0..31 run hidden/local/Clos/forward;32..63 run auxiliary weight then optional FP8 scale. Hidden state contains hidden/output/sync/book/plan but no weights. Every returning worker drains MTE; onlyphysical7 waits incoming.
Physical16..16+groupwidth-1 initialize hidden peer signals before PublishPeerAddresses. This role must not be lost when32 communication workers replace64 physical workers.

CacheClosDirectories then onlyphysical0 writes all three output addresses and generation; NativeStore+DDR barrier, VF put128+V_S wait+DDR barrier, then SyncAll<true>. This prelude executes before hidden/aux divergence. Aux does not create the descriptor awaited by hidden.

EnsureDeepepPeerAddress waits peer descriptor generation and acquires its cacheline; hidden uses this before remote output access. Clos directory cache onlyphysical8..23. Neither wait tests auxiliary inbox/header/output weight completion.

Local writers publish private done after CopyDeepepRows and DDR ordering; local worker0 waits every local writer then signals self primary readiness. All producers are hidden roles, not auxiliary owners.

Clos helper7 reads owner0..15 mailboxes/CQEs, waits pairedQP SO snapshots, publishes readiness and ACK. FinishClosSplit waits finalCQ and helperACK before quiet, then publishes done lanes0/1. These are hidden SQ/helper dependencies; no weight inbox/aux header is read.

ForwardPeer consumes hidden source-ready generation/forward metadata, locally expands hidden rows or issuesFM rows; local path drains MTE events+quiet; remote path FinishFmRows+UDMAQP0quiet precedes independent done lane2 publication.

Onlyphysical7 polls done lanes0/1 for nonlocal sources andlane2 forlocal peers, excluding self. Expected count has no gate-weight lane. Existing hidden incoming poll can finish without auxiliary packets; full kernel completion still joins the separately running auxiliaries.

Aux owner is physicalID-32, sends to(owner+p*32+rank)%world, waits peer epoch before writes, finishes all local sends/headers+MTEquiet/reuse before receive-loop over source=owner mod32. Receive waits independent weight header+packet generation and expands FP32 bits. No hidden ready/terminal wait is used.

Aux Put ordersV/S->MTE3, uses aclshmemx_mte_put_nbi for remote writes. Local MTE completion/UB reuse is distinct from remote packet generation visibility; do not replace packet waits by quiet or plain ready stores.

Aux shares four local MTE3_S ticketIDs0..3; pending tickets must be retired before NativeStore/WaitLocalPut can reuseID3. Original separate workers have private TPipe/UB; phased reuse needs an explicit completed-event/scratch boundary.

Notify prefix/directory use physical block IDs for partitioned metadata construction. They are separate Notify kernels, not Dispatch hidden/aux progress, but any fusedNotify path must retain their full partition coverage.

cycle_counterexamples_to_avoid: Moving descriptor publisher after hidden or auxiliary receive creates peer epoch/address waits on unpublished descriptors.

Running only some hidden roles to completion before scheduling helper7 or local-copy producers can deadlock existing helperACK/self primary waits; reuse32workers means concurrent32hidden roles, not one physical worker serially simulating allroles.
Retaining old64participant SyncAll while only32logical communication workers enter is not an established legal barrier.
Publishing next descriptor/recycling inbox before auxiliary receives finish lets another sender overwrite prior-generation weight packets; hidden done alone is insufficient for epoch retirement.
